interface.longDescription: "PRIMARY image recognition — use FIRST whenever user shares any image (local path, URL, attachment, screenshot, photo, diagram). Calls GLM vision models via MCP tool with automatic fallback (GLM-4.6V → GLM-4.1V-Thinking-FlashX → GLM-4.6V-Flash). Only fall back to 'vision' skill if this MCP tool is unavailable or fails. Triggers on: any image file, 'look at this', 'what's in this picture', 'describe this screenshot', 'analyze this image', '识别图片', '看看这张图'."
